```{r}
library(png)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
```

#read in intermediates

```{r}

#A (tapestation)
f_5a <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/filtering.png")  
p5_a <- ggdraw() + draw_image(f_5a)

#B C D (q vs length)
p5_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/p5_b.rds")
p5_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/p5_c.rds")
p5_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/p5_d.rds")
p5_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/p5_e.rds")
p5_f <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/p5_f.rds")
```

#----fig 5

extra margin for a

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
p5_a <- p5_a + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=15, 5, 5, 5))) 
p5_ab <- plot_grid(p5_a, p5_b, labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = 7, ncol=2, rel_widths = c(0.8, 1),   hjust = -0.8,
  vjust = 1.0)
p5_ab 
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3}
p5_d_e <- plot_grid(p5_d, p5_e, labels = c("d", "e"), label_size = 7, nrow = 2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 0)
p5_d_e
```

```{r}
p5_c_f <- plot_grid(p5_c, p5_f, labels=c("c", "f"), label_size = 7, nrow =2, rel_heights = c(0.7,0.5))
p5_c_f
```

```{r, fig.width=7}
p5_b_c_f<- plot_grid(p5_c_f, p5_d_e, label_size = 7, ncol = 2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 1.0, rel_widths = c(0.95, 0.8))
p5_b_c_f
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
p5_full_new <- plot_grid(p5_ab, p5_b_c_f, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(0.85,1))
p5_full_new
```


```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p5.pdf", plot=p5_full_new,width = 8.5, height = 5)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p5.png", plot=p5_full_new,width = 8.5, height = 5)
```
